description:
🚨 Book a free call to find the best health Insurance for you - https://www.fixyourinsurance.in 🚨 

Choosing the right health insurance for your parents is one of the most important financial decisions you’ll make. The wrong plan can leave you paying huge medical bills out of pocket.

In this video, you’ll learn:
🔹 How to pick the best health insurance policy for senior citizens
🔹 The 3 most important insurer credibility metrics – Complaints Ratio, Claim Settlement Ratio, Incurred Claim Ratio
🔹 Biggest mistakes to avoid – Room Rent Limits, Disease-wise Sub Limits, Co-pay, Deductibles
🔹 Must-have benefits – High Sum Insured, Restoration Cover, Minimal Waiting Period, Home Care Treatment, Annual Health Check-ups

Whether you’re buying a policy for aging parents or planning ahead, this guide will help you choose a plan that offers the right coverage, easy claims, and long-term affordability.

#BestHealthInsurance #SeniorCitizenInsurance #HealthInsurance2025 #InsuranceTips #financialplanningtips

comments.text:
Do not take a Star Health insurance policy. I lost ₹44,000 for a ₹5 lakh policy. I purchased the policy for my mother and father. My father had already undergone angiography, and I clearly informed the agent about all pre-existing diseases. The agent assured me that it would be covered under the policy.

However, without informing me, they removed my father from the policy. At the time of renewal, when I called customer care, I came to know that my father had been removed due to his surgery. The agent was already aware of this situation, but now he is not answering my calls.

After inquiry, the company said they had sent only one email regarding this removal, which I unfortunately missed. For policy renewal, I received daily calls, WhatsApp messages, and emails, but for removing my father from the policy, they sent just one email without proper communication.

Now, due to new policy rules, I am unable to get another health insurance policy for my father. If they had informed me properly last year, I could have applied for another policy at that time. I also did not receive any refund.

In case of a medical emergency, if I had applied this policy and then found out that my father was removed, who would have been responsible? Based on my experience, this has been very stressful and reflects extremely poor management.
